subject: general
question: For an angle measuring precisely 75 degrees, determine the numeric value of its sine multiplied by its cosine.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the double angle identity: sin(2θ) = 2 sin(θ) cos(θ).

Rearranging the formula: sin(θ) cos(θ) = (1/2) sin(2θ).

Substitute θ = 75°: sin(75°) cos(75°) = (1/2) sin(2 × 75°) = (1/2) sin(150°).

Since sin(150°) = sin(180° − 30°) = sin(30°) = 1/2.

The value is (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**
